Following his second date with Trump, Bill Maher is once again shocked at the ungentlemanly behavior of the twice-impeached POTUS.
On Friday’s episode of Real Time , the comedian reacted to Trump’s record-setting 1,300-word tweet disparaging Maher as a “complete and total loser,” following their dinner earlier this month.
“Did you see the 1,300-word tweet he sent out?” he asked the audience. “Longest ever. Kind of a flex. I tell you, dining at the White House is the opposite of the Cheesecake Factory. After you leave, they review you.”
Donald Trump Posts 1,300+ Word Sunday Night Diatribe About “Complete And Total Loser” Bill Maher, 9 Days After Praising Their “Great Dinner”
Donald Trump On Dinner With Bill Maher: “He Likes Me A Lot More Than People Understand, And I Actually Like Him”
Maher continued, “I mean, he went off on me like Kelly Clarkson in a toy store. Eating with Trump is like dating Taylor Swift. It”s a lot of laughs at the time, but later, they’re tearing you a new asshole.” Watch on Deadline
The host then pulled out a printout of the tweet, which he noted was “a little long,” describing it as “three pages of ‘who cares?'”
“Look, I have it here. I don’t want it to be this way. This whole point of having these dinners was talk, disagree but listen, which he does in person. But don’t hate each other. And then, I go back to my job here, and then the heartaches begin,” said Maher. “So, I’m not gonna refute everything, but I do want to address a few of the allegations.”
Before fact-checking Trump’s post, Maher conceded to Trump calling him a “complete and total loser,” admitting, “You got me there. OK, I’ll own that one.”
Following his dinner with Trump and Kid Rock last year, which the president called a “ total waste of time ,” Maher reunited with the group and Stephen A. Smith for another dinner this month.
